schema_note: Phase 3.2-H.1 candidate raw fingerprint manifest for MemoryAgentBench (candidate dataset preparation, NOT an active MAMBench dataset).

sources.clone_method: git clone --depth 1 (shallow clone, single commit, .git directory excluded from raw/ copy after cloning to a scratch location)
sources.note: This is the benchmark CODE + configs repository, not the data itself. It does not host the dataset's parquet files (those live on the HF dataset repo below); it contains task/eval configs, agent adapters, and README/LICENSE consulted for source audit.

sources.download_method: curl against https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai-hyz/MemoryAgentBench/resolve/main/<file> for README.md, entity2id.json, and all 4 data/*.parquet files
sources.note: This is the full HF dataset repo content as of the recorded revision sha: README.md (dataset card), entity2id.json (Movie Recommendation task auxiliary file, referenced by README), and all 4 parquet split files (Accurate_Retrieval, Test_Time_Learning, Long_Range_Understanding, Conflict_Resolution). Per the dataset card's own 'download_size': 74805902 bytes across the 4 parquet files -- ALL of it was downloaded (verified file sizes below match exactly), so this is FULL coverage of the published HF parquet data, not a partial sample.

top_level_digest_sha256_note: SHA-256 over the newline-joined, path-sorted list of "path:sha256" lines for every file below (this is the manifest-of-manifest digest, not a digest of file contents directly).
